scheme_name: Sikkim Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a regular student at a recognized college, university or school of a recognized board.
Must have a disability percentage of 40% or above certified by Medical Authorities as per the Persons with Disabilities Act, 1995.
Must pass the examination in one attempt during the academic session; failure makes the student ineligible for the same class in the next academic year.
Must not be receiving any other similar scholarship from other departments or ministries.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance covering cash incentives, books, stationery, uniforms and allowances for academic education and technical/professional training.
